fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (AMZN): Mizuho raised target price from $330 to $335, projecting AWS can achieve 40% annual revenue growth over the next two years.
fields.summary_ko.1: Amazon plans approximately $220 billion in capital expenditure this year, while other analysts set targets of Susquehanna $325, Evercore ISI $355, and Raymond James $250.
